# Draft:Search and Rescue of U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle Pilot during the 2026 Iran War

(example pictured) was shot down over Iran]]
During the 2026 Iran War, Iranian forces shot down a U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle fighter jet over the country, prompting a search and rescue mission by U.S. helicopters. One of the crew members was rescued by US forces. The downed U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle pilot was rescued on the 5th April.
